description: This PHP file defines a class 'CasesJjwg_MapsLogicHook' that contains logic hooks related to map and geocode information updates for cases within SuiteCRM. It handles events such as before save, after save, adding, and deleting relationships, integrating map geocode updates via the 'jjwg_Maps' module.

classes.name: CasesJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: A class implementing logic hooks for synchronizing geocode info and map data with SuiteCRM case records, reacting to various lifecycle events such as save and relationship changes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class and obtains module information for 'jjwg_Maps'.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode information for a case before it is saved, if the logic hooks are enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related meetings after a case is saved.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Handles updates when a relationship is added to a case, including geocode updates if address fields have changed.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Handles updates when a relationship is removed from a case, including geocode info refresh if the address has changed.
